# PRIME Daily

> PRIME Daily is a free app to start a good habit or quit a bad one. One clear step a day.
> PRIME Daily: אפליקציה חינמית להתחיל הרגל טוב או להפסיק הרגל רע. צעד אחד ברור כל יום.

PRIME Daily is a web app (installable on iPhone and Android) in Hebrew and English, made by Noam Cohen in Israel.

## What it does
- Pick one small habit to start (for example 2 pages of a book, a 5-minute walk) or one bad habit to quit (for example aimless scrolling, smoking, snoozing).
- For people starting from zero, it pairs the bad habit with a tiny good habit that replaces it, at the time the bad habit usually happens, with a daily reminder.
- Check it off once a day and watch the streak grow. Quit habits count clean days.
- Extras: a short daily lesson, a progress journal, and simple home workouts.

## Facts
- Price: free. No ads.
- Sign-up: optional. You can start as a guest.
- Platforms: any browser; add to home screen on iPhone (Safari) or Android.
- Languages: Hebrew, English.
